# Groovy fact counters (.groovy, .gvy, Spock specifications), for a rule with the shared prompt
# file-body-oop: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex), counted over the whole file. The
# [ignore] line runs first, leftmost region first: it blanks a shebang line, line and block comments,
# triple-quoted strings (''' and """), dollar-slashy strings, single- and double-quoted strings and a
# slashy regex after an operator, so a "def" or "class" in a GroovyDoc or a GString does not count.
# A region that is never closed runs to the end of the file (a slashy regex only to the end of its
# line). A Spock feature method is named by a string, "def 'reads an order'()": the string is
# blanked, so it counts as "def ()". "methods (approx)" counts typed and def methods with a body;
# "closures with parameters" a closure that names its parameters before "->". Counts are regex
# heuristics: a script's top-level statements, and a command expression without parentheses, are
# not methods. JvmFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that
# every pattern reads linearly.
[ignore] comments and string literals
type declarations
methods (approx)
Spock feature methods
Spock blocks
closures with parameters (approx)
static type checking
imports
